dosing_formula: 10 mg/kg IV over 60 minutes once every 4 weeks (adults); may decrease to 3 mg/kg IV over 60 minutes once every 4 weeks if 10 mg/kg not tolerated
preparation_instructions: Inspect visually for particulate matter/discoloration; solution should be clear to slightly opalescent, colorless to pale yellow — discard if cloudy, discolored, or particulate. Single-use vial; do not shake. Withdraw required volume and transfer into a PVC, polyolefin, or EVA IV bag containing 50 mL to 100 mL of 5% Dextrose Injection, USP for a final concentration of 0.9 mg/mL to 25 mg/mL. Mix by gentle inversion; do not shake; discard unused vial portion. Use immediately, or store diluted solution refrigerated at 2-8°C for up to 24 hours or at room temperature up to 25°C for up to 16 hours from preparation to start of infusion; do not freeze. Allow refrigerated solution to reach room temperature before administration. Infuse IV over 60 minutes using an infusion pump with a PVC, PE-lined PVC, or PU infusion set; a sterile in-line or add-on 0.2- to 5-micron PES or polyamide filter is recommended. Flush the line with 5% Dextrose Injection, USP after infusion. Do not mix or co-administer other drugs via the same line.
storage_requirements: Storage and Handling Store the unopened vial in a refrigerator at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F) in the original carton to protect from light. Do not freeze. Do not shake.
